title: Sales Specialist – Deep-Tech & Engineering Solutions
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated, technically inclined, and results\-driven **Sales Specialist – Deep\-Tech \& Engineering Solutions** to drive business growth for an advanced portfolio of engineering and technology solutions.

This is a **consultative B2B technical sales role** that requires a strong combination of engineering understanding, business development capability, customer engagement, and commercial acumen.

The selected candidate will work closely with customers, R\&D teams, engineering teams, channel partners, and senior leadership to identify business opportunities, understand technical requirements, position suitable solutions, and manage the complete sales lifecycle—from market development and lead generation to proposal submission, commercial negotiation, order closure, and customer engagement.

The role is based in **Kochi, Kerala**, and requires a candidate who is willing to build a long\-term career from Kerala while travelling extensively for customer meetings, product demonstrations, exhibitions, industry events, and business development activities.

Key Responsibilities1\. Business Development \& Market Expansion

* Identify, develop, and convert new B2B business opportunities across industrial, manufacturing, defence, technology, automation, and engineering sectors.
* Conduct market research to identify emerging opportunities, customer needs, industry trends, and competitor activities.
* Segment target markets and develop focused business development strategies.
* Build strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners, system integrators, and channel partners.
* Identify opportunities for new collaborations, partnerships, and market expansion.
* Develop new customer accounts while strengthening existing business relationships.

2\. B2B Technical Sales \& Customer Acquisition

* Manage the complete B2B sales lifecycle from prospecting and lead generation through proposal submission, negotiation, order closure, and after\-sales coordination.
* Generate and qualify leads through direct outreach, industry networks, digital channels, exhibitions, technical events, referrals, and strategic partnerships.
* Conduct technical presentations, product demonstrations, and solution discussions for customers and stakeholders.
* Understand customer requirements and position relevant engineering solutions.
* Develop sales strategies to achieve assigned revenue and business growth targets.
* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline with clear opportunity tracking and follow\-up.

3\. Consultative Customer Engagement

* Engage with CXOs, technical leaders, engineering teams, procurement teams, operations leaders, and other decision\-makers.
* Understand customer challenges, operational requirements, and technical use cases.
* Recommend suitable products and solutions through a consultative and value\-based sales approach.
* Translate complex engineering capabilities into clear business and operational benefits.
* Build long\-term customer relationships through regular engagement and proactive support.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth customer experience from initial engagement through implementation and after\-sales support.

4\. Technical Solution Coordination

* Work closely with R\&D and engineering teams to understand product capabilities, technical specifications, and application possibilities.
* Communicate customer requirements accurately to internal technical teams.
* Support solution discussions, technical evaluations, proof\-of\-concept activities, and product demonstrations.
* Coordinate with engineering teams to align proposed solutions with customer requirements.
* Gather customer feedback and share market insights to support product improvement and future development.

5\. Proposals, Commercials \& Negotiation

* Prepare technical and commercial proposals, quotations, presentations, and customer submissions.
* Coordinate with engineering, operations, and leadership teams to develop accurate and competitive solutions.
* Participate in commercial discussions and contract negotiations.
* Support pricing discussions while balancing customer value, business objectives, and profitability.
* Manage proposal follow\-ups and progress opportunities toward successful closure.
* Support order documentation and commercial handover after deal closure.

6\. Technology Marketing \& Brand Development

* Support technology marketing initiatives that communicate the value and applications of advanced engineering solutions.
* Contribute to product positioning, market messaging, and customer\-focused value propositions.
* Participate in webinars, exhibitions, technical conferences, industry events, and customer engagement programs.
* Support the review of technical marketing content, product brochures, presentations, case studies, and digital collateral.
* Work with internal teams to strengthen brand visibility and market awareness.

7\. Channel Partner Development

* Identify and onboard suitable channel partners, technology partners, system integrators, and business collaborators.
* Develop strategic partnerships to improve market reach and accelerate business growth.
* Support partner onboarding, training, engagement, and performance monitoring.
* Build strong relationships with partners to improve lead generation and market penetration.

8\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate closely with R\&D, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, and Customer Support teams.
* Ensure alignment between customer expectations, technical capabilities, and commercial commitments.
* Support new product launches and go\-to\-market initiatives.
* Share customer insights and market feedback to support product strategy and business planning.
* Contribute to a collaborative and customer\-focused work environment.

9\. Sales Reporting \& Performance Analysis

* Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, activity, and pipeline information in the CRM system.
* Prepare sales forecasts, revenue projections, and periodic business reports.
* Track key performance indicators and sales conversion metrics.
* Monitor opportunity progress and identify actions required to improve sales performance.
* Present market insights, customer feedback, and business performance updates to leadership.

Required Qualifications

* Engineering background in any discipline\*\* – Mandatory\*\*
* Minimum **5 years of proven experience** in B2B technical sales, engineering sales, industrial sales, or technology business development.
* Experience selling engineering products, industrial solutions, automation technologies, embedded systems, robotics, IoT, defence technologies, or technically complex solutions.
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand engineering products and communicate their value to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-management skills.
* Ability to manage the complete sales lifecycle independently.
* Experience using CRM tools and preparing sales forecasts or business reports.
* Willingness to work from **Kochi, Kerala**, and travel frequently for business requirements.

Must\-Have Skills

* B2B Technical Sales \& Business Development
* Engineering Product or Industrial Solution Sales
* Consultative Selling \& Customer Relationship Management
* Technical Presentations \& Solution Demonstrations
* Proposal Preparation \& Commercial Quotations
* Negotiation \& Deal Closure
* Customer Requirement Analysis
* Sales Pipeline Management
* Strong Written and Verbal Communication
* Willingness to Travel Frequently

Good\-to\-Have Skills

* Experience in Robotics, Embedded Systems, Industrial Automation, IoT, Deep\-Tech, Defence, or Advanced Engineering Solutions
* Channel Partner Development and Strategic Partnerships
* CRM Tools and Sales Forecasting
* Technology Marketing and Technical Lead Generation
* Market Research and Competitor Analysis
* Experience participating in technical exhibitions, industry events, or product launches
* MBA in Marketing, Sales, or Business Management

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Engineering background in any discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in B2B technical or engineering sales.
* Experience working with technically complex products or engineering solutions.
* Strong ability to understand technical concepts and communicate them clearly to customers.
* Comfortable engaging with CXOs, engineering leaders, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, and business decision\-makers.
* Proven experience in lead generation, customer acquisition, proposal development, negotiation, and deal closure.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently in a high\-growth environment.
* Candidates currently based in Kerala or willing to relocate to Kochi for a long\-term opportunity are preferred.
* Willing to travel extensively based on customer and business requirements.

Compensation \& Benefits

* **Annual CTC:** Up to ₹12 LPA, based on experience, technical sales expertise, and business potential.
* Attractive performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunity to work with advanced deep\-tech and engineering solutions.
* Exposure to robotics, embedded systems, industrial automation, intelligent sensing, and strategic technology applications.
* Direct collaboration with experienced engineering, R\&D, and leadership teams.
* High\-growth work environment with significant ownership and professional autonomy.
* Opportunities for career advancement and long\-term professional development.

Career Growth Path

**Sales Specialist → Senior Sales Specialist → Business Development Manager → Head – Business Development → Commercial Head / Business Unit Head**

Why Join Us?

* Work at the intersection of advanced engineering, innovation, and commercial growth.
* Build expertise in emerging deep\-tech and high\-value engineering solutions.
* Work closely with R\&D and engineering teams on real\-world technology applications.
* Take ownership of strategic customer relationships and market expansion.
* Contribute directly to the growth and commercial success of innovative products.
* Build a long\-term career in a fast\-growing, technology\-driven organization.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹3,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1743120
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Competency**



Client Excellence – Account Excellence

  

**Role Type**



Senior Account Coordinator

  


**The opportunity**



Senior Associate at C\&I team supports the Account Manager and the Account Leadership team; Global Client serving Partner, Global Client Executive to develop and manage relevant activities on designated Priority accounts. The Senior Account Coordinator will be expected to provide high quality and insightful support to account teams on Go\-to\-market activities. The Senior Account Coordinator will build network across the account leadership and within GDS to develop account knowledge to benefit the regional/global Account team and our relationship and business with the client.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


**Account Management**


* Own account reporting and ensure relevant stakeholders receive and understand reported data
* In liaison with the Client Service Partner and Director, own the account planning process and ensure regular reviews against planned milestones and targets.
* Understand the strategic communication and stakeholder engagement requirements to progress the account plan agenda, and work with global teams to respond and deploy
* Provide relevant knowledge to Account teams – focus on dissemination of business analysis and research, competitive intelligence and relevant firm thought leadership
* To liaise and work with onshore account teams and internal business services groups to scope new support requirements, build processes for the execution of account management tasks, and ensure effective transition of work to the remote GDS support platform
* Client Relationship Development
* Contribute to complex account and business development needs, including global account planning, go\-to\-market research and strategy, pursuit or sales support, pitch development, among others
* Work with BMC point of contact to plan and execute marketing initiatives that directly drive revenue
* Accelerate strategy execution, particularly around prioritized Regions and strategic solutions.
* Understand market trends, what is on our clients' agenda and how these translate into revenue generating opportunities. Monitor solution revenue to understand success, opportunities, underperformance
* Communication
* Coordinate with global network of regional account team meetings. Send updated account and sector content and information.
* Develop and maintain relationships with service lines, Accounts, Market Segments, Emerging Markets and subsectors to serve as a two\-way conduit for connection and communication
* Responsible for working to develop high impact relationships and embedding ABD support into the processes of the accounts
* Responsible for project management, quality control, review of deliverables, and for embedding the principles of exceptional client service of being connected, responsive and insightful in our support to the account teams and ABD stakeholders
* Facilitation of knowledge sharing

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Succinct and structured oral and written communications skills with proven ability to explain complex concepts in a crisp, clear, concise, and graphic\-rich style, using appropriate analytics and visualization tools.
* Experience in Account Management and preparing sales and pipeline reporting, as well as providing insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients
* Experience in Microsoft tools like excel and PPT

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**


* Any Graduate
* 4\-8 years' experience in Account management and data reporting and analysis
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Demonstrated strong written and oral communication skills
* Ability to use both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis methodologies, including financial analysis skills, to synthesize information, review data inputs and provide analytic insights

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* Account Management and data reporting skills
* Exposure to tools like Tableau, PowerBi etc.
* Credible experience working in a fast\-moving, client\-driven environment

  


**Technologies and Tools**

* Microsoft 365 Products, Apps, and Services
* Experience using Procurement portals (i.e., SAP Fieldglass or Ariba)

  


**What we look for**


* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* A professional with strong interpersonal skills \- confidence, maturity \& ability to build strong client relationships

  


**What we offer**



EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.


* **Continuous learning**: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success, as defined by you**: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership**: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
